answer_1.quote: We test SESCORE2's English checkpoint over a diverse set of NLG tasks: Machine Translation, Speech Translation, Data-to-Text, and Dialogue Generation.

answer_2.quote: We compute segment‑level Kendall correlation between metric outputs and human scores ... We include three n‑gram, distance‑based baseline metrics: BLEU, ChrF and TER; four best performed learned metrics without human ratings: PRISM, BARTScore, BERTScore and SEScore; and two SOTA supervised metrics: COMET and BLEURT.

answer_4.quote: We hired 3 professional linguists to annotate 1000 testing samples from WMT21 De‑En News domain using MQM human evaluation procedures. ... Each rater can only access the source (in German) and model output (in English), without any reference text. Rater is given all the choices of possible error typologies and definitions of the severity levels.
answer_4.guideline: MQM evaluation procedure with error typologies and severity levels (major/minor)
